description: Source code for a Postgres vector store node implementation, including class definition, methods for upsert and delete, and initialization logic for vector store retrieval and configuration.

classes.name: Postgres_VectorStores
classes.description: Implements a vector store node for Postgres, supporting upsert, delete, and initialization for retrieval or vector store output.

methods.name: vectorStoreMethods
methods.description: Contains methods for upserting documents into and deleting documents from the Postgres vector store.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the vector store or retriever based on node data inputs and configuration.

methods.name: getDriverFromConfig
methods.description: Returns the appropriate VectorStoreDriver instance based on configuration, defaulting to TypeORMDriver.
